name: math-app
description: Flutter + Rust math learning app for kids (Vietnam market)

scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:e2e
scripts.setup:e2e: cd e2e && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:backend
scripts.format: cd frontend && dart format --fix . && cd ../backend && cargo fmt && cd ../e2e && npx prettier --write .
scripts.lint: cd frontend && flutter analyze && cd ../backend && cargo clippy -- -D warnings
scripts.clean: cd frontend && flutter clean && cd ../backend && cargo clean
